title: Generate simplified procedural NYC scenery
acceptance: the compiler/runtime can represent simplified surrounding city massing using real building footprints and available heights where useful without requiring photorealistic building models
representative buildings are generated or batched with a deliberately simple material/style system that keeps draw calls and geometry bounded by the active streaming region
scenery collision is limited to what driving needs and does not create physics bodies for every decorative object by default
missing heights or attributes use documented deterministic fallback rules rather than pretending invented values are source-accurate
building/geographic data attribution and any procedural art dependencies are included in the project attribution inventory
verification: PR #13 final production-only head ce29d9d1 passed npm run check, full map-compiler tests, project health, lint/types/schemas, and Roach coordination on Ubuntu and Windows. A live Flatiron refresh compiled 797 NYC Building Footprints with 796 source HEIGHT_ROOF values and 1 explicitly labeled deterministic fallback. Chromium run 33464991251 artifact 9784529075 rendered the scenery with zero page/console errors and a stable 4/4-wheel Roadbed reset.

evidence.work: Added NYC Building Footprints acquisition and normalization, real roof-height conversion with explicit deterministic fallback policy, terrain-consistent building grounding, 256 m tile scenery serialization, one merged Three.js building mesh per streamed tile, visual-only scenery collision policy, regenerated 797-building Flatiron fixture, attribution/provenance documentation, and compiler/runtime regression coverage.
